name: MeteoAlarm CAP feed for Portugal
gives: Every CAP warning message in MeteoAlarm's Portugal feed, one line each: area, hazard, level, onset, expiry, time of issue and text, with what appeared or left since the read before.

terms.summary: MeteoAlarm: re-users must name the national service (IPMA), keep the time of issue, link www.meteoalarm.org and publish MeteoAlarm's disclaimer. latest.json carries all four.
